tr.td: Contracts, Arrangements, Understandings or Relationships With Respect to Securities of the Issuer

td.div:
The information contained in Item 6 of the Schedule 13D is hereby amended and supplemented by adding the following information:
On October 27, 2026, People entered into Amendment No. 1 (the "Amendment") to the Voting Agreement (the "Voting Agreement") dated April 3, 2026 with the Issuer and Barry Diller.
Pursuant to the Amendment, People, Mr. Diller and their respective controlled affiliates (collectively, the "Covered Entities") agreed not to acquire securities of the Issuer (or related derivative instruments) if doing so would cause their aggregate beneficial ownership to exceed 29.9% of the Issuer's outstanding common stock, except that an increase above that threshold resulting from the Issuer's own repurchases, redemptions or other acquisitions of its securities will not constitute a breach, so long as the Covered Entities make no further acquisitions while above 29.9%.
Additionally, at any time a matter, other than a change of control transaction, is brought to a stockholder vote or consent of the Issuer's stockholders, the Covered Entities will vote any voting securities they beneficially own in excess of 25.73% of the total voting power of the outstanding voting securities of the Issuer on each matter in the same manner as the majority of the voting securities of the Issuer (other than those held by (x) the Covered Entities, (y) the Issuer's directors and executive officers, and (z) any controlled affiliates of the Issuer's directors or executive officers) are voted on such matters (disregarding voting securities that are not voted).
With respect to any vote or consent of the Issuer's stockholders in connection with a change of control transaction, the Covered Entities will vote all voting securities they beneficially own in accordance with the recommendation of the Issuer's Board of Directors (the "Issuer Board"), so long as: (i) any directors designated by People under the Voting Agreement serve on any transaction committee of the Issuer Board for that transaction (unless they decline to serve or their serving would give rise to a conflict of interest under applicable Delaware law); (ii) the transaction is with a third party unaffiliated with the Issuer, its controlled affiliates, or its directors or executive officers; (iii) unless the Covered Entities consent otherwise, their equity securities receive the same form and amount of consideration per share, and are subject to the same terms and conditions, as securities of the same class held by other stockholders, provided that if any consideration to be received by the Covered Entities consists of securities, the Issuer will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide them with liquidity opportunities for those securities; and (iv) the transaction does not impose any new or additional restrictions on the Covered Entities with respect to the surviving, resulting or acquiring entity. If any of the foregoing conditions is not satisfied, the Covered Entities will not be subject to any restrictions with respect to the voting securities they beneficially own in connection with such change of control transaction.
In addition, for so long as the Covered Entities are in compliance with the Voting Agreement, the Issuer agreed not to implement any stockholder rights plan or other defensive measure or action, in each case that is primarily designed or intended to be adverse to the Covered Entities or that the Issuer knows would be disproportionately adverse to the Covered Entities relative to other holders of the same class of equity securities of the Issuer. The foregoing restrictions do not (i) apply to any statements made by the Issuer in response to, or in connection with, any proxy contest, proxy solicitation or other contested solicitation of stockholder votes or consents involving the Issuer and its voting securities initiated, conducted or participated in by any of the Covered Entities, or (ii) limit actions taken by the Issuer directed at third parties who have agreed to purchase or have purchased a significant percentage of the Issuer's outstanding voting securities from the Covered Entities, and the Covered Entities will notify the Issuer prior to consummating any such sale.
The Amendment also provides that, with respect to the termination of the Voting Agreement, a change of control of the Issuer will not result from the Covered Entities, acting alone or as part of a group, in one or a series of transactions, acquiring beneficial ownership of voting securities possessing a majority of the total voting power of the voting securities of the Issuer, unless such transaction is specifically approved by the Issuer Board as a "change of control" under the Voting Agreement.
The above summary is not complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Voting Agreement, filed as Exhibit 1 to Amendment No. 7 to this Schedule 13D, and of Amendment No. 1 to the Voting Agreement, which is attached hereto as Exhibit 2, and each of which is incorporated herein by reference.
